name: KJTS Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，KJTS Group Berhad 的拟议收购因买卖协议失效而未能完成，涉及冷却能源板块的扩展计划相应调整；同时，公司通过多项谅解备忘录继续推进与 Medi-City 的 district cooling system 合作及 Green AI 相关合作，但年内未见重大进展。最新一季营收同比翻倍，净利润同比增长约79%。
overview_en: In 2026, KJTS Group Berhad's proposed acquisition lapsed due to the expiry of the sale and purchase agreement, and the related expansion plan for the cooling energy segment was adjusted accordingly. Meanwhile, the company continued to pursue collaborations related to the Medi-City district cooling system and Green AI through memorandums of understanding, with no material developments during the year. Latest quarterly revenue doubled year-on-year, with net profit up about 79%.

segments.name: 冷却能源
segments.note: 年内拟议收购因买卖协议失效而未能完成，冷却能源板块的扩展计划相应调整；同时继续推进 Medi-City 区域供冷系统合作及 Green AI 相关合作。
segments.note_en: The proposed acquisition lapsed during the year due to the expiry of the sale and purchase agreement, and the expansion plan for the cooling energy segment was adjusted accordingly;

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 FBG Land Sdn. Bhd. 及 The Penang Development Corporation 就 Medi-City 区域供冷系统基础设施的战略合作协议，自上次公告以来无重大进展。
actions.text_en: The strategic collaboration agreement with FBG Land Sdn. Bhd. and The Penang Development Corporation for the district cooling system infrastructure for Medi-City has no material development since the last announcement.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 拟议收购因买卖协议失效而未能完成，原用于业务扩展（包括冷却能源板块扩展）的上市集资款项用途恢复至招股书原定安排，并将相关时间框架延长24个月。
actions.text_en: The proposed acquisition lapsed due to the expiry of the sale and purchase agreement; the utilisation of IPO proceeds earmarked for business expansion (including expansion of the cooling energy segment) reverts to the original arrangement in the prospectus, wi…

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 拟议收购的买卖协议因两项先决条件未获满足或豁免而于2026年2月4日失效，卖方将退还订金。
actions.text_en: The sale and purchase agreement for the proposed acquisition lapsed on 4 February 2026 as two conditions precedent were not fulfilled or waived, and the vendor will refund the deposit.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 年内就 Green AI Sdn. Bhd. 与 Shenzen Envicool Technology Co. Ltd. 的谅解备忘录发布季度更新，未披露具体业务板块归属。
segments.note_en: Quarterly updates were issued during the year on the memorandum of understanding between Green AI Sdn. Bhd. and Shenzen Envicool Technology Co. Ltd., without specifying the business segment.
